steps.title: Branch and phase plan
steps.summary: Created branch phase-01-spec from main (Phase 0 merged as f42d833); plan posted in chat and written to docs/preview/status.json. Documentation only: no product code changes.

steps.title: SPEC §1–3: purpose, terminology, trust model
steps.summary: Scope, design goals, terminology, trust boundaries, and the assumptions the rest of the spec depends on.

steps.title: SPEC §4: identities and key hierarchy
steps.summary: account_id/device_id, the SP1 Secret Key format with checksum, Argon2id + HKDF MUK, OPAQUE auth secret, account key, Ed25519/X25519/ML-KEM identity keys, device certification and revocation, vault keys and item keys.

steps.title: SPEC §5–6: encryption format and op log
steps.summary: XChaCha20-Poly1305 envelopes, deterministic-CBOR AAD with every bound field, HKDF purpose labels, the hash-chained op DAG, conflict resolution, signed heads and rollback/fork detection.

steps.title: SPEC §7: relay API and transports
steps.summary: OPAQUE register/login, session tokens, every endpoint and its shapes, size limits, quotas, rate limits, generic errors, and the http/folder/memory Transport implementations.

steps.title: SPEC §8–10: scoring, sharing, recovery, inventory
steps.summary: Dashboard score formula and weights, sharing (HPKE, key transparency, safety codes), recovery (printable kit, 2-of-3 guardians, 72 h cancel), and the crypto inventory with versioning rules.

steps.title: THREAT_MODEL part 1: adversaries A1–A8
steps.summary: One table per adversary (malicious relay, network, sharee, malicious page, stolen locked device, malware, supply chain, hostile extension): assets, attacks, mitigations with SPEC links, residual risk.

steps.title: THREAT_MODEL part 2: mappings and open risks
steps.summary: ETH Zurich 2026 malicious-server classes and the DEF CON 33 DOM clickjacking attack mapped to specific mitigations; open risks carried forward plus new design risks.

steps.title: Decisions: PROPOSED entries for every gap
steps.summary: Every detail the prompt left open is proposed in docs/DECISIONS.md as PROPOSED (D-01xx) and mirrored to the Notion Decisions database for the founder's review.

steps.title: Diagrams: key hierarchy and trust boundary
steps.summary: Two hand-written SVGs under docs/diagrams/: password + Secret Key to MUK to AK to vault keys to item keys, and the relay trust boundary. Embedded in SPEC.md and rendered on the preview page.

steps.title: Preview Docs tab with TOC, tests and screenshots
steps.summary: Safe Markdown renderer (DOM nodes only, no innerHTML), Docs/Status tab switcher, table of contents for SPEC and THREAT_MODEL, unit tests, light/dark/narrow screenshots.

steps.title: Self-attack review, PROGRESS entry and PR
steps.summary: At least 10 design-level attack vectors, each blocked by a named SPEC clause or recorded as an open risk; GitHub issues, Notion risks, PROGRESS.md entry, final checks, PR closing #7.

try_it.label: Proposed build checks
try_it.command_or_url: .\x.ps1 "cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings && cargo test --all && cargo deny check"

risks.title: R-0001 — CodeQL code scanning is skipped while the repository is private (needs GitHub Advanced Security); gitleaks, cargo-deny, cargo-audit and clippy still run (issue #23)
R-0002 — Link targets in status.json are trusted from the repository; a malicious PR could point a card at a phishing page (mitigated by PR review)
R-0003 — The local preview dev server needs style-src 'unsafe-inline' for Vite hot reload; loopback-only, no third-party data, must not be copied into product UI
R-0004 — gitleaks can miss novel secret formats; mitigated by a manual staged-diff scan before every commit
R-0005 — minimatch advisory (GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249, moderate DoS) in the dev-only ESLint toolchain; never shipped, CI fails on high/critical via pnpm audit --audit-level high
